mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the FEDFUNDS rise is temporary (e.g., drops below 4.5% within a month), the 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 6% for three consecutive months predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 6% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: If UNRATE peaks and then declines within the 60-day window, returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in UNRATE and PAYEMS above their 5-year averages predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE and PAYEMS both exceed 5-year averages
failure_condition: If one variable rises while the other falls, returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in GDPC1 growth rate exceeding 5% for two consecutive months predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate exceeds 5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth slows or reverses within the 5-day window, returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in GDPC1 coupled with a decline in INDPRO predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by >10% while INDPRO decreases by >5% in the same month
failure_condition: If the changes are not both significant or occur in different months, returns are not positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO growth above 2% for three consecutive months predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth exceeds 2% for 3 consecutive months
regime_hint: supply-side expansion in a growth cycle
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth slows or turns negative within the 60-day window, returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in INDPRO and RSAFS above their 10-week moving averages predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: Both INDPRO and RSAFS exceed 10-week moving averages
failure_condition: If one variable rises while the other falls, returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
